Tune in to 9to5Mac for a curated daily news summary just for you. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, and Google Play. If you use Overcast or another podcast player, you can subscribe via our RSS feed.

This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get all those little things out of your head and into a simple, elegant system, so nothing slips through the cracks and you can ease your mental load. It's an easy-to-use to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make it easier and more satisfying to organise, track, and tick off your tasks. Every task, handled by Stuff.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform, and we'll deliver each episode straight to your ears the moment it's released.

The news covered in this episode:

  • Apple announces price increases for Apple TV and Apple One subscription services
  • iPhone 18 Pro pre-order dates may be slightly later than previous years
  • Report suggests Apple Watch Series 12 could feature all-day heart rate monitoring and a brand-new Fitness app
